verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any native Asana capability for creating or organizing shared docs, notes, or wikis alongside projects. The Notion, Canva, and Figma entries are third-party integrations that sync or embed content, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. The community comment about free-form notes is ambiguous and is not affirmative evidence.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
